hook: Your train waits while the bridge itself lifts into the air.
title: The Indian Rail Bridge That Rises Into the Air
description:
The new Pamban Bridge near Rameswaram has a middle span that rises vertically so ships can pass. It is India's first vertical-lift sea bridge. Trains wait until it lowers again.

#Shorts #Geography #India
comment_prompt: Would you wait for it? Yes or no
